cleaner.label: Minikube cache
cleaner.description: Images, ISOs and binaries downloaded by Minikube. Does not touch profiles, machines or configuration.

option.label: Minikube cache
option.description: Removes ISOs, container images, preloaded archives and Kubernetes binaries from the cache.
option.warning: Files are re-downloaded on the next `minikube start`: network required and it can take several minutes.
